H1.bd:
1) father of an individual
2) of God as father of his people
3) head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
4) ancestor
4a) grandfather, forefathers - of person
4b) of people
5) originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
6) of producer, generator (fig.)
7) of benevolence and protection (fig.)
8) term of respect and honour
9) ruler or chief (spec.)
Also means: av (אַב "father" H0002)
H1.g: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H1.k: chief, (fore-) father(-less), patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

H10.d: the same as H9 (אֲבֵדָה), miswritten for H11 (אֲבַדּוֹן);

H100.bd:
1) rush, bulrush
1a) used as cord or line (of twisted rushes or spun of rush fibre)
1b) of the lowly, insignificant (metaph)
2) sad, drooping
1a) of line of bulrushes
1b) bowing of the head (fig.)
1c) of the lowly (metaph)
H100.d: from the same as H98 (אֲגַם); a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication
H100.g: a bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes

H1001.bd:
castle, citadel, palace
Aramaic of bi.rah (בִּירָה "palace" H1002)

H1002.bd:
1) palace, castle
2) temple
Aramaic equivalent: bi.ra (בִּירְתָא "citadel" H1001)

H1004.g: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1004.k: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).

H1005.g: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)

H1007.bd:
§ Beth-aven = "house of vanity"
a city east of Bethel
H1007.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H205 (אָוֶן); house of vanity;

H1008.bd:
§ Bethel = "house of God"
ancient place and seat of worship in Ephraim on border of Benjamin, identified with Luz (former name)
H1008.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H410 (אֵל); house of God;

H1009.bd:
§ Beth-Arbel = "house of God's Ambush"
a place in Palestine, perhaps Gilead or Galilee
H1009.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H695 (אֶרֶב) and H410 (אֵל); house of God's ambush;

H101.bd:
1) bowl, basins
1a) basins used in ritual
1b) human body (metaph), curves of the body (simile)
1c) of family of Eliakim (metaph)

H1010.bd:
Beth-meon = "house of Meon"
a city in the territory of Reuben
Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)
H1010.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal);
H1010.k: Beth-baal-meon. Compare H1186 (בַּעַל מְעוֹן) and H1194 (בְּעֹן).

H1011.bd:
§ Beth-birei = "house of a creative one"
a place in the territory of Simeon
H1011.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1254 (בָּרָא); house of a creative one;

H1012.bd:
Beth-barah = "house of (the) ford"
a place on the Jordan
Also named: Bēthabara (Βηθαβαρά,Βηθανία "Bethany" G0962)
H1012.d: probably from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5679 (עֲבָרָה); house of (the) ford;

H1013.bd:
§ Beth-gader = "house of the wall"
a place in Judah
H1013.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1447 (גָּדֵר); house of (the) wall;

H1014.bd:
§ Beth-gamul = "house of recompense"
a place in Moab
H1014.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the passive participle of H1576 (גְּמוּל); house of (the) weaned;
H1014.g: Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan

H1015.bd:
Beth-diblathaim = "house of the two fig-cakes"
a place in Moab
Another name of al.mon div.la.ta.ye.mah (עַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה "Almon-diblathaim" H5963)
H1015.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the dual of H1690 (דְּבֵלָה); house of (the) two figcakes;
H1015.g: Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan

H1016.bd:
§ Beth-dagon = "house of Dagon"
the temple of Dagon in Judah
H1016.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1712 (דָּגוֹן); house of Dagon;
H1016.g: Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine

H1017.bd:
Bethelite = "house of God"
an inhabitant of Bethel
Another name of bet-el (בֵּֽיתְ־אֵל "Bethel" H1008G)
H1017.d: patrial from H1008 (בֵּית־אֵל) with the article interposed;
H1017.g: a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel

H1018.bd:
§ Beth-ezel = "house of narrowing"
a place in Judah
H1018.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H681 (אֵצֶל) with the article interposed; house of the side;

H102.bd: wing (of an army), band, army, hordes
H102.d: probably from H5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e.
H102.g: (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops

H1020.bd:
§ Beth-jesimoth = "house of the desolation"
a place in Moab given to the tribe of Reuben
H1020.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H3451 (יְשִׁימַה) with the article interposed; house of the deserts;
H1020.g: Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan

H1021.bd:
§ Beth-haccerem = "house of the vineyard"
a place in Judah
H1021.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3754 (כֶּרֶם) with the article interposed; house of the vineyard;

H1022.bd:
Group of bet le.chem (בֵּית לֶ֫חֶם "Bethlehem" H1035)
§ Bethlehemite = "house of bread"
an inhabitant of Bethlehem
H1022.d: patrial from H1035 (בֵּית לֶחֶם) with the article inserted;
H1022.g: a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem

H1023.bd:
Beth Ham-merchaq = "remote house"
house or settlement on the bank of Kidron
H1023.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4801 (מֶרְחָק) with the article interposed; house of the breadth;

H1024.bd:
Beth-marcaboth = "house of the chariots"
a place in Simeon
Another name of mad.man.nah (מַדְמַנָּה "Madmannah" H4089G)
H1024.d: or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H4818 (מֶרְכָּבָה) (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots;
H1024.g: Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine

H1025.bd:
§ Beth-emek = "house of the valley"
a place on the border of Asher
H1025.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6010 (עֵמֶק) with the article interposed; house of the valley;

H1026.bd:
§ Beth-arabah = "house of the desert valley" or "place of the depression"
a place in Judah or in Benjamin
H1026.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6160 (עֲרָבָה) with the article interposed; house of the Desert;

H1027.bd:
Beth-aram = "place of the height"
a place in Gad
Also named: bet ha.ran (בֵּית הָרָן "Beth-haran" H1028)
H1027.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7311 (רוּם) with the article interposed; house of the height;
H1027.g: Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan

H1028.bd:
Beth-haran = "house of their mount: house of the joyful shouter"
a place in Gad, possibly "Beth Harran", one hour east of Jordan, opposite Jericho
Another name of bet ha.ram (בֵּית הָרָם "Beth-haram" H1027)
H1028.g: Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan

H1029.bd:
§ Beth-shittah = "house of the acacia tree" or "place of the acacia"
an unknown location, perhaps an acacia grove
H1029.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7848 (שִׁטָּה) with the article interposed; house of the acacia;

H1030.bd:
Bethshemite or Beth-shemeshite = "house of the sun"
an inhabitant of Beth-shemesh
Another spelling of bet she.mesh (בֵּית שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ "Beth-shemesh" H1053)
H1030.d: patrial from H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ) with the article inserted;
H1030.g: a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh

H1031.bd:
§ Beth-hoglah = "house of the partridge" or "place of partridge"
a place in Benjamin on the border with Judah
H1031.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the same as H2295 (חׇגְלָה); house of a partridge;

H1032.bd:
§ Beth-horon = "house of hollowness"
two towns in Ephraim
1a) Upper Beth-horon-town on the mountains of Ephraim
1b) Lower Beth-horon-town located 800 feet (245 m) lower than Upper Beth-horon
H1032.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H2356 (חוֹר); house of hollowness;
H1032.g: Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine

H1033.bd:
§ Beth-car = "house of the ram" or "place of the lamb"
a place apparently belonging to the Philistines
H1033.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3733 (כַּר); house of pasture;

H1034.bd:
§ Beth-lebaoth = "house of lionesses"
a place in Simeon
H1034.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H3833 (לָבִיא); house of lionesses;

H1035.bd:
§ Beth-lehem = "house of bread (food)"
a city in Judah, birthplace of David
H1035.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3899 (לֶחֶם); house of bread;

H1036.bd:
Bethel-aphrah = "house belonging to Aphrah" or "house to (i.e. of) dust"
a Philistine city
Another name of oph.rah (עׇפְרָה "Ophrah" H6084G)
H1036.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of H6083 (עָפָר) (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust;

H1038.bd:
Beth-maachah = "house of pressure"
a place in the northern kingdom
Combined with a.vel (אָבֵל "Abel" H0059H)
H1038.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); house of Maakah;

H1039.bd:
Beth-Nimrah = "house of the leopard"
a place east of the Jordan in Gad
Also named: nim.rah (נִמְרָה "Nimrah" H5247)
H1039.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of H5246 (נָמֵר); house of (the) leopard;
H1039.g: Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan

H104.bd:
letter, missive (Aramaic loan-word used in last OT books)
Aramaic of ig.ge.ret (אִגֶּ֫רֶת "letter" H0107)
H104.g: an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman)

H1041.bd:
Beth-azmaveth = "house of the strength of death"
a place near Jerusalem
Also named: az.ma.vet (עַזְמָ֫וֶת "Azmaveth" H5820K)
H1041.g: house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine

H1042.bd:
§ Beth-anoth = "house of responses (or afflictions)"
a place in Judah
H1042.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a plural from H6030 (עָנָה); house of replies;

H1043.bd:
§ Beth-anath = "house of response (or affliction)"
a place in Naphtali
H1043.d: an orthographical variation for H1042 (בֵּית עֲנוֹת);

H1044.bd:
§ Beth-eged = "house of binding" i.e. "shearing house"
a place in the northern kingdom
H1044.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative of H6123 (עָקַד); house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing);

H1046.bd:
§ Beth-palet = "house of escape" or "place of escape"
a place in southern Judah
H1046.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6412 (פָּלִיט); house of escape;

H1047.bd:
§ Beth-peor = "house of Peor"
a place east of the Jordan, in the land of the Amorites, allotted to the tribe of Reuben
H1047.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); house of Peor;
H1047.g: Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan

H1048.bd:
§ Beth-pazzez = "house of dispersion"
a place in Issachar
H1048.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative from H6327 (פּוּץ); house of dispersion;

H1049.bd:
§ Beth-zur = "house of the rock"
a place in Judah
H1049.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6697 (צוּר); house of (the) rock;

H1050.bd:
Beth-rehob = "house of the street"
a place in Dan on road to Hamath
Also named: re.chov (רְחוֹב "Rehob" H7340K)
H1050.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7339 (רְחֹב); house of (the) street;

H1051.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7497 (רָפָא); house of (the) giant;

H1052.bd:
§ Beth-shean or Beth-Shan = "house of ease"
a place in Manasseh, west of the Jordan
H1052.d: or בֵּית שָׁן; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7599 (שָׁאַן); house of ease;
H1052.g: Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine

H1053.bd:
§ Beth-shemesh = "house of the sun" or "sun-temple"
a town in southwest Judah
H1053.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); house of (the) sun;

H1054.bd:
§ Beth-tappuah = "house of the apple" of "place of apples"
a town in Judah
H1054.d: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); house of (the) apple;

H1056.bd:
Baca = "weeping"
a valley in Palestine
Combined with to.phet (תֹּ֫פֶת "Topheth" H8612)

H1057.bd:
1) balsam tree-a shrub which drips sap when it is cut
2) possible name of a vale of balsam trees in Ps 84:6
H1057.g: the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam)

H1058.bd:
1) to weep, bewail, cry, shed tears
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to weep (in grief, humiliation, or joy)
1a2) to weep bitterly (with cognate acc.)
1a3) to weep upon (embrace and weep)
1a4) to bewail
1b) (Piel) participle
1b1) lamenting
1b2) bewailing
H1058.k: at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, more, mourn, sore, with tears, weep.

H106.d: from H1640 (גָּרַף) (in the sense of grasping);

H1060.bd:
1) firstborn, firstling
1a) of men and women
1b) of animals
1c) noun of relation (fig.)

H1061.bd:
1) first-fruits
1a) the first of the crops and fruit that ripened, was gathered, and offered to God according to the ritual of Pentecost
1b) the bread made of the new grain offered at Pentecost
1c) the day of the first-fruits (Pentecost)

H1062.bd: birthright, primogeniture, right of the first-born
H1062.g: the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture

H1063.bd:
1) first-ripe fig, early fig
2) (TWOT) firstfruits
Also means: bak.ku.rah (בִּכּוּרָה "firstfruit" H1073)

H1065.g: a weeping; by analogy, a dripping

H1066.bd:
Bochim = "weeping"
a place near Gilgal (or Bethel), where sons of Israel wept
Another name of bet-el (בֵּֽיתְ־אֵל "Bethel" H1008G)
H1066.d: plural active participle of H1058 (בָּכָה); (with the article) the weepers;

H1067.bd:
1) firstborn daughter, firstborn (of women)
1a) always used of women

H1069.bd:
1) to be born first
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to bear early, new fruit
1a2) to give the right of the firstborn
1a2a) to make as firstborn
1a2b) to constitute as firstborn
1b) (Pual)
1b1) to be born a firstling
1b2) to be made a firstling
1c) (Hiphil) one bearing her first child
H1069.d: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from H1061 (בִּכּוּר))
H1069.k: make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

H107.bd:
letter, missive
Aramaic equivalent: ig.g.ra (אִגְּרָא "letter" H0104)

H1070.d: from H1069 (בָּכַר) (in the sense of youth);

H1071.g: Beker, the name of two Israelites

H1072.bd: a young female camel, young camel, dromedary

H1073.bd:
1) first ripe fig, early fig
2) (TWOT) firstfruits

H1075.bd:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.20.1;
father of: Sheba (H7652A)
Also named: be.ri (בֵּרִים "Bichrite" H1276)
§ Bichri = "youthful"
1) a Benjamite, father of Sheba
adj
2) (BDB) the Bichrites

H1076.g: a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker

H1077.g: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H1077.k: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

H1078.g: Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians

H1079.bd:
mind, heart
Aramaic of lev (לֵב "heart" H3820A)
H1079.g: properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat)

H108.d: from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of enveloping);

H1080.bd:
1) (Pael) to wear away, wear out
1a) to harass constantly (fig.)
H1080.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה) (but used only in a mental sense);

H1081.d: from H1078 (בֵּל) and H113 (אָדוֹן) (contracted); Bel (is his) lord;
H1081.g: Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince

H1082.bd:
1) to gleam, smile
1a) (Hiphil) only
1a1) to show a smile, look pleasant
1a2) to cause to burst
H1082.g: to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction)

H1083.bd:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.14
§ Bilgah = "cheerfulness"
1) a priest of the 15th course, in David's time
2) a priest accompanying Zerubbabel
H1083.g: Bilgah, the name of two Israelites

H1084.bd:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.10.8; also called Bilgai at Neh.10.8;
Another name of bil.gah (בִּלְגָּה "Bilgah" H1083H)
§ Bilgai = "my cheerfulness"
a priest who covenanted with Nehemiah

H1085.bd:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Job.2.11
§ Bildad = "confusing (by mingling) love"
the second friend of Job

H1086.bd:
1) to wear out, become old
1a) (Qal) to wear out
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to wear out
1b2) to wear out by use, use up completely
1b3) to enjoy, use to the full
Aramaic equivalent: be.la (בְּלָא "to wear out" H1080)
H1086.g: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)
H1086.k: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

H1088.bd:
§ Balah = "waxed old"
a place in Simeon

H1089.d: a primitive root (rather by transposition for H926 (בָּהַל));

H109.bd:
1) to grieve, cause grief
1a) (Hiph) to cause to grieve, to grieve, to cause grief

H1090.bd:
A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.29; married to Israel (H3478);
mother of: Dan (H1835H) and Naphtali (H5321)
§ Bilhah = "troubled"
Rachel's handmaid whom she gave to Jacob as a concubine, mother to two of Jacob's children, Dan and Naphtali
H1090.g: Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine

H1092.g: Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

H1093.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה);

H1095.bd:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.14.14; also called Belteshazzar at Dan.1.7; 2.26; 4.8,9,18,19; 5.12; 10.1;
Another name of da.niy.yel (דָּנִיֵּאל, דָּנִאֵל "Daniel" H1840G)
§ Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
1) the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he bec…

H1096.bd:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.14.14; also called Belteshazzar at Dan.1.7; 2.26; 4.8,9,18,19; 5.12; 10.1;
Aramaic of da.niy.yel (דָּנִיֵּאל, דָּנִאֵל "Daniel" H1840)
§ Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
1) the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became th…

H1097.bd:
subst
1) wearing out
adv of negation
2) without, no, not
H1097.g: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H1097.k: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

H11.bd: Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin

H110.d: probably from H109 (אָדַב) (in the sense of chastisement) and H410 (אֵל); disciplined of God;

H1100.bd:
